questions.question: Dr. Malika has a conflict with her assistant who claims payment for overtime. Dr. Samira advises consulting the Labor Code. According to Article 198, what is the principle of overtime payment?
options: Overtime is paid at the end of the year
Overtime is paid in a single payment together with the salary
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Article 198 of the Labor Code provides that overtime is paid in a single payment together with the salary due.' Dr. Malika: 'I will regularize the situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has an employee who committed professional misconduct. Dr. Malika advises following a progressive disciplinary procedure. What is the first step of this procedure?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The disciplinary procedure must be progressive. The written warning is the first step.' Dr. Samira: 'I will send them a warning.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika is summoned to labor court following the dismissal of her assistant. Dr. Samira advises seeking legal assistance. Why is this assistance important?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'A lawyer specializing in labor law can help defend the practice's interests before the labor court.' Dr. Malika: 'I will consult a lawyer.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a conflict with her assistant who refused to undergo a medical examination. Dr. Malika reminds her of the employee's obligations. According to the Labor Code, what can the employer do?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Refusal of a medical examination may lead to disciplinary sanctions.' Dr. Samira: 'I will initiate the procedure.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has received a complaint for moral harassment from her assistant. Dr. Samira advises conducting an internal investigation. What is the first step of this investigation?
options: Request the withdrawal of the complaint
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Hearing the parties is an essential step in understanding the situation.' Dr. Malika: 'I will listen to both parties.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has an employee who resigned without notice. Dr. Malika reminds her of the consequences of resignation without notice. According to the Labor Code, what is the situation?
options: The employee must pay a notice indemnity
The employee can leave without consequences
The employee has no right to resign
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Resignation without notice may result in the payment of a notice indemnity.' Dr. Samira: 'I will request payment of the indemnity.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a conflict with her assistant regarding the year-end bonus. Dr. Samira advises consulting the collective bargaining agreement. What is the source of applicable law?
options: The dental sector collective bargaining agreement
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The dental sector collective bargaining agreement may provide specific conditions for bonuses.' Dr. Malika: 'I will consult the collective bargaining agreement.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has an employee who was the victim of a workplace accident. Dr. Malika reminds her of the employer's obligations. According to the Labor Code, what must the employer do?
options: Ask the employee to pay for treatment
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Any workplace accident must be reported to CNSS within legal deadlines.' Dr. Samira: 'I will make the declaration.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with a supplier regarding a non-compliant delivery. Dr. Samira advises sending a formal notice to the supplier. What is the legal value of a formal notice?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The formal notice is proof that the supplier was informed of the problem.' Dr. Malika: 'I will send a formal notice.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a dispute with her landlord regarding the amount of rent. Dr. Malika advises referring the matter to the conciliation commission. What is the role of this commission?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The conciliation commission attempts to find an amicable agreement between the tenant and the owner.' Dr. Samira: 'I will refer to this commission.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a conflict with a colleague regarding patient sharing. Dr. Samira advises applying Article 53 of the Code of Ethics. What is the rule?
options: The colleague can take the patient without warning
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Article 53 encourages joint consultation between colleagues in the patient's interest.' Dr. Malika: 'I will propose a joint consultation.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a dispute with her landlord regarding compliance work. Dr. Malika reminds her of the owner's obligation. According to Law 49-16, who is responsible for compliance work?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The owner is required to maintain the premises and keep them compliant with standards.' Dr. Samira: 'I will remind the owner of this obligation.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a conflict with her assistant regarding paid leave. Dr. Samira advises consulting the Labor Code. According to Article 30, how many days of paid leave is the assistant entitled to?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Article 30 of the Labor Code provides for 21 days of paid leave per year for employees.' Dr. Malika: 'I will check my assistant's leave balance.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has an employee who went on strike. Dr. Malika reminds her of the rules for strikes in the private sector. According to the Labor Code, what is the notice period?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The Labor Code provides for a 72-hour notice period to declare a strike.' Dr. Samira: 'I will check compliance with this deadline.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with her landlord regarding the non-execution of work. Dr. Samira advises having the situation documented by a bailiff. What is the usefulness of this documentation?
options: It is evidence for court proceedings
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The bailiff's report constitutes evidence in the event of court proceedings.' Dr. Malika: 'I will call a bailiff.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a conflict with her assistant who refuses to sign her employment contract. Dr. Malika reminds her of the employment contract obligation. According to the Labor Code, is the employment contract mandatory?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The employment contract is mandatory. The employment relationship must be formalized in writing.' Dr. Samira: 'I will insist that she sign it.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with a supplier regarding non-payment of an invoice. Dr. Samira advises proposing an amicable settlement. What is the alternative in case of failure of this attempt?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'In case of failure of the amicable attempt, court proceedings are the alternative.' Dr. Malika: 'I will first try an amicable solution.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a conflict with her assistant regarding a bonus. Dr. Malika advises consulting the employment contract. What is the source of applicable law?
options: The employment contract and the collective bargaining agreement
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Bonuses are governed by the employment contract and the collective bargaining agreement.' Dr. Samira: 'I will check these documents.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with her landlord regarding rental charges. Dr. Samira advises requesting a breakdown of charges. According to Law 49-16, what is the procedure for regularization?
options: Request a detailed statement of charges
Immediately refer the matter to court
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The tenant has the right to request a detailed breakdown of charges.' Dr. Malika: 'I will request this breakdown.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a conflict with a colleague regarding a scientific publication. Dr. Malika reminds her of Article 49 of the Code of Ethics. What is the rule?
options: Credit for a discovery may be attributed to a single author
It is forbidden to improperly claim credit for a discovery
The colleague may be excluded from the publication
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Article 49 forbids improperly claiming credit for a scientific discovery.' Dr. Samira: 'I will respect loyalty between colleagues.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has received a formal notice from her landlord. Dr. Samira advises not ignoring this letter. Why is this important?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Ignoring a formal notice can worsen the situation and lead to court proceedings.' Dr. Malika: 'I will respond to the letter.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a conflict with her assistant regarding working conditions. Dr. Malika advises establishing internal regulations. What is the advantage of internal regulations?
options: They clarify everyone's rights and obligations
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Internal regulations clarify everyone's rights and obligations and prevent conflicts.' Dr. Samira: 'I will draft internal regulations.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a dispute with her supplier regarding defective products. Dr. Samira advises making a reservation upon receipt. What is the legal value of this reservation?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The reservation upon receipt constitutes proof of the defect noted.' Dr. Malika: 'I will always make reservations.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a conflict with her assistant regarding the remuneration of paid leave. Dr. Malika advises consulting Article 30 of the Labor Code. What is the principle of leave remuneration?
options: Leave is paid during the leave period
Leave is paid at the end of the year
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Paid leave is remunerated during the leave period.' Dr. Samira: 'I will ensure leave is paid.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika, after managing several staff conflicts, receives congratulations from Dr. Samira. What is the next step for Dr. Malika?
options: Become a reference in dental HR management
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Mastery of HR management is a valuable skill. Becoming a reference is the next step.' Dr. Malika: 'I will train in HR management.'
